title: Fuel / scar numeric fix (analytic Olson + scar fade)
simLoop: runFuelAccumulationStep and decayFireScar used explicit Euler with a clamped decay coefficient, so fuel equilibrium and scar lifetime depended on tick size. Both now use the analytic exponential form; fireScarDecayK lives in config.ts.
gameLoop: Fuel load and burn scars no longer jump or vanish when the clock takes a large step — a decade of litter and a fading scar mean the same thing whether the band fired once or many times.
notebookSeed: The scar is fading, not snapping off — and the litter under the stand does not care how big the last time step was.
tierO: no owner-only question — Refinement is CI-judged.
